approvers: Owner decides alone; glazing subcontractor and developer would have to agree
reason: Damage to installed glazing before handover is the glazing subcontractor's problem, not mine, so I have no budget line for this and no reason to add a new supplier. A coating sprayed on coated glass and frames is also a worry for me, because it could mark or stain the finishes.
objection: I do not pay for glazing protection and I would not risk a peelable coating on coated glass and frames. If it left residue or marked a frame, I would be the one answering for it.
instead: Keep doing what we do now: cheap protection film and tape on frames, and leave glazing damage with the subcontractor until handover.
would_change_my_mind: A glazing manufacturer's written approval of the coating on coated glass and frames, plus a developer who requires it and pays for it as a separate line.
